name: Rite of Vision
summary: Across Mulgore, young tauren gather offerings for the Rite of Vision. In Bloodhoof Village, Zarlman Two-Moons guides them as they brew the Water of the Seers and seek counsel from ancestral spirits.

sections.title: The Reagents of the Land
sections.body: Zarlman Two-Moons sends you across Mulgore for well stones and ambercorn. The stones rest near sacred communal wells, while ambercorn falls beneath the roots of ancient trees. To the tauren, these are more than gifts from the land. They carry the Earth Mother's latent magic and lifeblood, ready for the rite.

sections.title: Brewing the Water of the Seers
sections.body: Zarlman combines the well stones and ambercorn to brew the Water of the Seers. You drink it beside the village's tribal flame. The draught clears your mind and summons an ethereal guide. Then you follow the guide across the plains, testing whether you can walk between the physical world and the land's spiritual whispers.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Rite of Vision?
faq.answer: The Rite of Vision tests tauren coming of age as they seek their path. You prepare and drink the Water of the Seers, then learn to commune with spirits and follow ancestral omens across Mulgore's plains.

Zarlman Two-Moons is a tauren shaman and seer in Bloodhoof Village. He oversees spiritual trials for young adventurers, prepares ritual draughts such as the Water of the Seers, and interprets signs of the Earth Mother.

faq.q: Where are well stones and ambercorn found?
faq.answer: Well stones lie near freshwater wells scattered across Mulgore. Ambercorn falls at the bases of large trees across the surrounding grassy land.

faq.q: What happens after drinking the Water of the Seers?
aliases: what happens next rite of vision
faq.answer: Near the tribal fire, drinking the Water of the Seers opens your spiritual sight and reveals a ghostly animal guide. You follow the spirit across the plains to find the next stage of your sacred journey.

faq.q: Why do the tauren revere water wells so deeply?
faq.answer: Water is Mulgore's lifeblood and a precious gift of the Earth Mother. Tauren revere the wells as sacred communal centers that nourish the land and its herds. The stones gathered beside them carry spiritual power.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to further rites?
aliases: next quest in rite of vision
is rite of vision a chain
faq.answer: Yes. The ceremony has several stages. After Zarlman prepares the Water of the Seers, you drink it, track the vision that appears, and present yourself to elder leaders across Mulgore.

angles.text: As a tauren, you reach a cultural milestone that binds you to the spiritual heritage of the Earth Mother and the ancestors, whether you are a warrior, hunter, or mystic.
As a shaman, you recognize the Water of the Seers as a traditional grounding ritual. It attunes your spirit to read unseen elements before you speak directly with spirits.
As a druid, you revere ambercorn and well stones as signs of the plants and life-giving waterways that sustain Mulgore's balance.
